abstract: Chapter 14 explores The Final Journey through the lens of Brahman, revealing the universal truths woven into the Mahabharata narrative.
objectives: Understand the role of Brahman in The Final Journey.
Analyze key character motivations in Chapter 14.
Connect philosophical teachings to real-world ethics.

content_blocks.content: The narrative of Chapter 14 centres on The Final Journey. The characters face choices that test the boundaries of Brahman — the cosmic order that governs all actions.

content_blocks.english_translation: You have a right to perform your duty, but not to its fruits.
content_blocks.content: This verse defines selfless action — the bedrock of the Gita's teaching.
Brahman as explored in The Final Journey reveals that true freedom lies in detachment from outcome while remaining fully committed to righteous action.
By the end of Chapter 14, the reader understands that the battlefield of Kurukshetra is also the battlefield of the human mind — where every soul must choose between ego and truth.
